ignore.config/meta/AdapterTypes.js: QML types of config keys, read by tools/config/gen_adapters.cjs (node), not by QML
ignore.modules/components/kit/: shared UI kit (Type, Space, controls): the vocabulary every screen is being rebuilt from; consumers migrate screen by screen (render: tools/render/kit_render.py)

notSnapshotted.theme.sr*.label: constant display name of a variant, not user-editable

summaryKey/bodyKey/labelKey/args of backend notify.request (timers, tasks, usage, routines in backend/pkg/svc), translated by modules/notifications/NotifyRequest.js
prompt preset descriptions of the backend term.presets (assets/terminal/prompts/*.json description keys), shown by modules/terminal/PromptGallery.qml

allow._comment: <file> -> why it must stay one file (reported as info, not as a warning)
allow.install.sh: the curl | bash installer must be a single self-contained file; it is split into sections and covered by tests/install-sh.test.py

brandLiterals._comment: The legacy name may only appear in legal files, the README credits line, migration and legacy-compat code. Everything else derives the identity from backend/pkg/brand, modules/globals/Brand*, scripts/lib/brand.*.

allow.backend/pkg/brand/*: the identity itself (legacy id for compatibility)
allow.modules/globals/BrandActions.js: the identity itself (legacy id for compatibility)
allow.scripts/lib/brand.*: the identity itself (legacy id for compatibility)
allow.backend/cmd/yozakura/legacy*.go: refuses to start next to a running legacy session
allow.backend/pkg/mods/*_test.go: legacy manifest fixtures and third-party repo URLs
allow.modules/services/ai/ChatStore.qml: compatibility with older binaries' chatlist output
allow.docs/mods/*: legacy manifest file name and key, still read
allow.install.sh: legacy env var fallback, migration note
allow.scripts/install-sddm-theme.sh: removes a previous legacy SDDM theme install
allow.docs/upstream/*: upstream license and trademark terms, kept for reference

brandLiterals._comment: The external compositor daemon yozd replaced may only be named in legal files, the README (credits and install notes), the migration of its files, the identity (legacy-bind compatibility) and the installer that removes it.

allow.backend/pkg/migrate/*: migration of the legacy daemon's files
allow.backend/pkg/brand/*: the identity itself (legacy daemon name for old bind command lines)
allow.modules/globals/BrandActions.js: the identity itself (legacy daemon name for old bind command lines)
allow.install.sh: removes the legacy daemon binary on upgrade
allow.docs/upstream/*: upstream license and trademark terms, kept for reference

shellInjection._comment: Data reaches child processes as argv, never as code: no createQmlObject source and no sh -c script built with + / ${} / .arg() / .join(). Allow entries are '<file>::<substring of the flagged expression>' -> reason.

allow.config/KeybindActions.js::BrandActions.a: compositor bind command line; the only spliced value is the constant app id
allow.config/CustomBindDefaults.js::BrandActio: compositor bind command line; the only spliced value is the constant app id
allow.modules/widgets/dashboard/wallpapers/Wal: find predicates built from the constant EXTENSIONS list; the folders are passed as "$@"

ignore.modules/components/kit: shared UI kit with no shell consumer yet; the first `import qs.modules.components.kit` in a scanned file makes the scanner reach it

layers._comment: Layer order for tools/audit/checks/layers.py (lower layers must not import higher ones). Baseline of today's violations: tools/lint/baselines/layers.json (ratchet).

ipcMethods._comment: QML -> backend method names are checked against assets/schema/ipc-methods.json (generated by `make schema`). wrappers: helper calls whose first argument is a method (optionally prefixed, optionally limited to files). dynamicAllow: <file> -> why its non-literal method names are fine.

dynamicAllow.modules/services/TasksService.qml: call() wrapper that prefixes tasks.; every call site is checked through the wrappers list
dynamicAllow.modules/services/TimersService.qml: call() wrapper that prefixes timers.; every call site is checked through the wrappers list
dynamicAllow.modules/services/RoutinesService.qml: call() wrapper that prefixes routines.; every call site is checked through the wrappers list
dynamicAllow.modules/services/AppHooksService.qml: _one() wrapper that prefixes apphooks.; call sites are checked through the wrappers list
dynamicAllow.modules/services/ExclusiveService.qml: _run() wrapper; call sites are checked through the wrappers list
dynamicAllow.modules/services/ModsService.qml: request() wrapper; call sites are checked through the wrappers list
dynamicAllow.modules/services/Screenshot.qml: ocr.text / ocr.barcode picked by a ternary on the recognition kind (both exist in the registry)
dynamicAllow.modules/services/Notifications.qml: NotifyRequest actions run methods named by the backend's notify.request payload (timers, tasks, usage ...), not by QML
dynamicAllow.modules/services/ai/ProviderSetup.qml: method comes from ProviderConnect.testCall: providers.test / providers.ollama.probe (both exist in the registry)
dynamicAllow.modules/services/FocusMode.qml: TimersService.call(completed ? "dismiss" : "cancel") (both timers methods exist in the registry)
